VERL.forward_scope: Original VERL masked-mean logprob assertion applied only before the first update, at identical weights. Later independent updates have different weights and are diagnostics, not this official same-weight test. No individual-token, gradient or whole-PPO threshold is inferred.
VERL.gradient_scope: The pinned VERL gradient assertion, unchanged, applied to first-update LoRA gradients at matched initial weights/inputs/advantages. Upstream tests a q_proj gradient under sequence parallelism; these are additional actor-seam cases, not an unchanged upstream test or a general optimizer-update tolerance.
VERL.not_claimed: No published whole-PPO optimizer-update tolerance or two-update whole-model certificate is inferred.

vLLM_batching_base.scope: Original v0.15 hybrid test_batching and check_logprobs_close; individual versus batched vLLM, four actual saved AppWorld prompts,64 generated tokens/top5; token/top-k membership comparison, not scalar logprob allclose.
